title: Tipped Arrow Recipes
description: Tipped Arrow Recipe Datapack for "Fletching Recipe" Mod by CoolerProYT
body:
This is a recipe datapack for the mod [Fletching Recipe](https://modrinth.com/mod/fletching-recipe) by CoolerProYT, without it this datapack does not work. This datapack is made for the **1.21.1 NeoForge** Version.

Use regular potions to make batches of eight and sixteen arrows; and lingering potions for batches of thirty-two and sixty-four. I recommend using [Dragons Breath Recipe](https://modrinth.com/datapack/dragons-breath-recipe) or making your own data pack for easier access to dragons breath for the lingering potions.
